'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza humanitarian crisis]]
***Fourteen people are killed, including three children who died of [[hypothermia]], amid a severe storm in the [[Gaza Strip]]. At least 13 homes previously damaged by [[Israel]] have also collapsed. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/12/12/live-at-least-10-people-die-in-gaza-in-past-24-hours-amid-storm (Al Jazeera)]
*At least eight people are killed and multiple others are injured when a [[tank truck]] crashes and explodes in [[Tiko]], [[Southwest Region (Cameroon)|Southwest Region]], [[Cameroon]]. [https://www.africanews.com/2025/12/12/fuel-tanker-explosion-kills-at-least-eight-people-in-cameroon// (Africanews)]
*Four people are killed and eleven others are rescued when an under-construction building on top of a [[Hindu temple]] collapses in [[Verulam, KwaZulu-Natal|Verulam]], [[KwaZulu-Natal]], [[South Africa]]. **The [[United States]] [[United States Department of the Treasury|Treasury Department]] lifts [[United States government sanctions|sanctions]] on [[Brazil]]ian [[Supreme Federal Court|Supreme Court]] Justice [[Alexandre de Moraes]], citing a shift in [[Foreign policy of the United States|U.S. foreign policy]]. '''Law and crime'''
*[[Corruption in Bolivia]]
**A [[Bolivia]]n judge orders former [[President of Bolivia|president]] [[Luis Arce]] into five months of [[pre-trial detention]] in [[La Paz]] while authorities investigate alleged [[embezzlement]] linked to the diversion of public funds for projects in [[Indigenous peoples in Bolivia|Indigenous communities]] during his tenure as [[Ministry of Economy (Bolivia)|economy minister]] [[Presidency of Evo Morales|under Evo Morales]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bolivia-judge-rules-ex-president-arce-be-held-pre-trial-detention-five-months-2025-12-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Corruption in the Philippines]]
**Civil society groups and church representatives file complaints against [[Philippine]] [[Vice President of the Philippines|vice president]] [[Sara Duterte]] at the [[Office of the Ombudsman (Philippines)|Office of the Ombudsman]], accusing her of [[plunder]], violations of Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act, [[bribery]], and [[betrayal of public trust (1987 Philippine Constitution)|betrayal of public trust]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-12-12/philippines-vice-president-duterte-faces-fresh-graft-complaint (Bloomberg)] [https://www.rappler.com/philippines/plunder-complaint-sara-duterte-confidential-funds-december-2025/ (Rappler)]
*[[Police Command of the Islamic Republic of Iran|Police]] in [[Mashhad]], [[Iran]], arrest [[Nobel Prize|Nobel]] laureate [[Narges Mohammadi]] during a ceremony honoring deceased lawyer and human rights activist [[Khosrow Alikordi]].
